name: act_boundary_crossing_v4
purpose: The seeds the full-run training smoke walks to ask whether the training stack can carry one episode across an act boundary. A reach-directed list used to test a mechanism, never to estimate how deep a policy gets.
measured_by: G1_act_pools.dynamic_sample.deepest_episode_rows -- the only 4 of the declared 10,000-seed act1 checkpoint partition whose campaign episode ended in a deeper act than it started
strength_is_not_measured_here: 4 of 10,000 seeds crossed, deepest floor 19, campaign clears 0. That is the number the first training run exists to move, and the smoke reports it without judging it.
